hints.title: Sliding Window Frequency State
hints.text: Maintain the frequency of elements in a sliding window of length k using element counters.

hints.title: Mode Resolution
hints.text: Identify the element having maximal frequency in the active window breaking ties by minimum value.

hints.title: Running Window Summation
hints.text: Slide the window by incrementing the new element count, decrementing the leaving element, and adding the mode.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sliding window frequency tracking across all k-sized subarrays.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing frequencies from scratch for every window takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains frequency map of size at most K.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implement sliding window frequency transitions cleanly.
